name: @treedy/lsp-mcp
description: Unified MCP server aggregating multi-language LSP backends for code intelligence

scripts.test:integration: bun run build:bundled && bun test test/integration
scripts.test:benchmark: bun run build:bundled && LSP_MCP_SINGLETON_BACKEND=false bun test test/integration/ts-zod.test.ts test/integration/semantic-navigate.test.ts test/integration/diagnostics-delta.test.ts test/integration/python-fastapi.test.ts test/integration/vue-vitesse-deep.test.ts test/integration/vue-vitesse-language-workspace.test.ts test/integration/vue-vitesse-semantic-recovery.test.ts test/integration/mixed-root-benchmark-matrix.test.ts
scripts.benchmark:report: bun run build:bundled && bun run scripts/benchmark-report.ts --out .tmp/benchmark-latest.json

author: treedy
